column1: # Babi Palace sequential event: Iodem recounts the search for Babi at Altmiller Cave.

column3: We searched Altmiller\nCave, as you ordered.{end_wait}
And what did you learn?\nDid you find any sign\nof Lord Babi?{end_wait}
Iodem, why send us into\nsuch a dangerous place\nto search for him?{end_wait}
Why would Lord Babi\nenter that cave alone?\nIt makes no sense...{end_wait}
You were going to say\nit was impossible,\nweren't you?{end_wait}
Altmiller Cave is a\nplace of ill omen.{end_wait}
If Lord Babi went in\nalone, something in\nthere may have...{end_wait}
I know the cave's{pause_20_skippable}...{pause_20_skippable}...{pause_20_skippable}\npeculiar nature.{end_wait}
You knew about it?\nThen why send us there?{end_wait}
Lord Babi has slipped\naway in secret before...{end_wait}
You mean this is not\nthe first time he has\ndisappeared, Iodem?{end_wait}
Do you know where\nhe went on those\nother occasions?{end_wait}
I once followed\nLord Babi myself...{end_wait}
I was certain he had\nentered Altmiller Cave...{end_wait}
Did you search the\ncave after him?{end_wait}
What was Lord Babi\ndoing in that place?{end_wait}
He entered the cave,\nthen vanished{pause_20_skippable}\nbefore my eyes.{end_wait}
So you lost sight\nof him inside?{end_wait}

I followed him past
the cave entrance...{page_break}but he was gone.
There was no trace
of where he went.{end_wait}

I followed him again
on several occasions.{page_break}Each time, he vanished
moments after crossing
the threshold.{end_wait}
Do you believe he\nwent there again\nthis morning?{end_wait}
But he always returned\nfrom Altmiller Cave\nbefore now...{end_wait}
Then surely he will\nreturn soon?{end_wait}
No. This time is\nnot the same. Something\nabout it troubles me.{end_wait}
It is strange that he\nleft just before Colosso.{page_break}But there is another\nmatter I cannot ignore...{end_wait}
Lord Babi's bed had\nnot been slept in\nthis morning.{end_wait}
What does that\nhave to do with it?{end_wait}
He did not sleep there\nlast night. That is\nwhat troubles me.{end_wait}
Lord Babi has been\nmissing since last night.{end_wait}
That is why I fear\nsomething has happened.\nHe has never done this.{end_wait}
We had no idea he\nhad been gone so long...{end_wait}
You don't think Lord\nBabi was ki{em_dash}{end_wait}
Do not speak such\nthings! Lord Babi is\nalive somewhere!{end_wait}
I will attend Colosso\nin Lord Babi's place.\nYou must find him...{end_wait}
We will search again.\nEvery one of us.{end_wait}
Lord Babi... Where\nhave you gone?{end_wait}
